<script>
    window.prerenderReady = false;

    const params = {"timeoutMs":10000,"successDelayMs":1000,"components":["page","mfe-reservation","mfe-dynamic-offers","mfe-featured-fleet","mfe-newsletter-signup"]};
    (function (components, timeoutMsVal, successDelayMs) {
        const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
        const isDebug = urlParams.has('debug');

        function watchComponentsReady(options) {
            var expected  = options?.expectedComponents ?? [];
            var timeoutMs = options?.timeoutMs ?? 15000;
            var successDelayMs = options?.successDelayMs ?? 1000;
            const eventName = "ComponentReady";

            if (isDebug && !Array.isArray(expected) || expected.length === 0) {
                console.log("[watchComponentsReady]: no expected components specified");
            }

            var received = new Set();
            var done = false;
            var resolveFn;
            var timeoutId;

            function finish(reason, isSuccess) {
                if (done) return;
                done = true;

                window.removeEventListener(eventName, listener);
                if (timeoutId) clearTimeout(timeoutId);

                // Internal wrapper to execute shared logic + promise resolution
                const completeProcess = function() {
                    window.prerenderReady = true;
                    resolveFn({reason: reason});
                };

                if (isSuccess && successDelayMs > 0) {
                    if (isDebug) console.log("[watchComponentsReady]: All loaded. Waiting " + successDelayMs + "ms before setting prerenderReady.");
                    setTimeout(completeProcess, successDelayMs);
                } else {
                    completeProcess();
                }
            }


            function listener(event) {
                var componentName = event && event.detail && event.detail.componentName;
                if (expected.indexOf(componentName) === -1) return;

                if (!received.has(componentName)) {
                    received.add(componentName);
                    if (received.size === expected.length) {
                        finish("[watchComponentsReady]: All Components loaded", true);
                    }
                }
            }

            window.addEventListener(eventName, listener);

            timeoutId = setTimeout(function () {
                var missing = expected.filter(function (name) {
                    return !received.has(name);
                });
                var msg = "Timeout";
                if (missing.length > 0) {
                    msg = "[watchComponentsReady] timeout. Missing Components: " + missing.join(", ");
                }
                finish(msg, false);
            }, timeoutMs);

            return new Promise(function (resolve) {
                resolveFn = resolve;
            });
        }

        window.watchComponentsReady = watchComponentsReady;

        if (components && Array.isArray(components) && components.length > 0) {
            watchComponentsReady({ expectedComponents: components, timeoutMs: timeoutMsVal, successDelayMs: successDelayMs}).then(function (result) {
                if (isDebug) {
                    console.log(result.reason);
                }
            });
        } else {
            if (isDebug) {
                console.log("No Components to watch.");
            }
            window.prerenderReady = true;
        }
    })(params.components, params.timeoutMs, params.successDelayMs);
</script>

    <script type="text/javascript">
        // For ABP protection
        const tokenFetchFactory = function () {
            let protectionCache = null;
            const waitingOnProtection = [];

            window.protectionLoaded = function (protection) {
                protectionCache = protection;
                for (const resolve of waitingOnProtection) {
                    resolve(protection);
                }
                waitingOnProtection.length = 0;
            };
            function protectionObject(jsTimeout = 1000) {
                if (protectionCache !== null) {
                    return Promise.resolve(protectionCache);
                }

                return new Promise((resolve) => {
                    waitingOnProtection.push(resolve);

                    const timeout = setTimeout(
                        () => {
                            resolve(null);
                        },
                        jsTimeout,
                    );
                });
            }

            const getToken = function (jsTimeout = 1000, tokenTimeout = 1000) {
                return protectionObject(jsTimeout)
                    .then((protection) => {
                        if (protection === null) {
                            return null;
                        } else {
                            return protection
                                .token(tokenTimeout)
                                .catch(() => {
                                    return null;
                                });
                        }
                    });
            };

            return getToken;
        };

        window.getAbpToken = tokenFetchFactory();
    </script>
